program.name: Stride Strength
program.subject: Running prep
program.blurb: Strength for runners in three days: hips, then calves and feet, then single-leg control.
program.about: Slow, steady strength for the parts running wears out: hips, calves, feet and knees. Three days rotate, glutes and hips, calves and feet, then single-leg control, all in straight sets with full rests. Each session ends with abs. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down, which is where tendons get strong. Pair it with two or three runs a week.
